pages.text:
Lucille — seating for the 17th, as Edmund wants it for the photograph and for below:

A ring, not a table. Eight places marked on the floor with brass pins, as the Record requires. Seven chairs. Leave the eighth place bare — no chair. Edmund says if she comes she will stand there, by the door, and that is how it was always meant to be.

I drew the ring twice. It still has eight places.
